DIAGNOSIS READY: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome (SJS) / Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (TEN).

The clinical picture of coalescing erythematous macules, bullae, desquamation on the upper back, and oropharyngeal ulcers is highly specific for SJS/TEN. The vital signs indicate a significant stress response with tachycardia, while the normal blood counts argue against simple iron deficiency anemia. We must immediately stop any potential offending medications and initiate supportive care.
